messages:
anya: Opening a tiny docs PR to add a compact function-calling example for a price lookup + a one-line JSON Schema and short SDK snippets (JS/Python/Go). Quick pre-check?

ben: include both null-return and error cases. reviewers want explicit fallback guidance.

anya: plan: prompt -> tool call -> tool returns -> assistant structured reply. keep it under 10 lines.

julia: example draft:
```
User: 'Get price for sku 314'
Assistant -> call price_lookup(sku=314)
Tool returns: {"price_cents":1999,"currency":"USD"}
Assistant final: {"price_display":"$19.99"}
```

kevin: compact JSON Schema suggestion (one-liner): {"type":"object","properties":{"price_cents":{"type":["integer","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["currency"]} and note price_cents may be null on tool failures.

anya: adding fallback examples: tool returns {"price_cents":null} -> show "unknown price" UI; tool errors -> retry/soft-fail message.

ben: SDK snippets: show parse helper for JS/Py and add a tiny Go example since we haven't shown Go snippets in these small PRs yet. keep them one-liners.

anya: JS: `const parsed = Responses.parseStructured(resp)`; Py: `parsed = validate_structured(resp)`; Go: `parsed := ParseStructured(resp)` (docs pseudo-API). Add a note: parsing/validation is client-side, not enforced by runtime.

julia: add an eval case in the PR body so QA can auto-check: prompt -> expected {"price_display":"$19.99"}. Also use canonical link ids: docs/schema-best-practices and docs/parse-conventions.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build started for PR #3507"

kevin: tiny copy nit: change "guardrails enforce" -> "docs recommend validating on the client side".

anya: updated, sanitized snippets with `./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh`, squashed into commits: example/schema/snippets/links. pushing now.

docbot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3507"

ben: LGTM, merging after CI. follow-up: extended runbook with canonical shim functions and more Go examples.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
